{{Quote|The only thing that I can think of to help me out is if you go in with the droid and don't let the Mandalorians blow it up. If you are willing to do that, you have way more guts than I would ever have.|Labsol Renuffi|<ref name="Galaxies">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''R2-F4''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] that operated during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Circa [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was under the command of [[Labsol Renuffi]], a [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who worked in the [[Death Watch bunker]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. When a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] entered the bunker, Renuffi tasked a member of the group with protecting R2-F4, so that the droid could fix the main [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|exhaust ports]].
